### workspace statusline --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace statusline

Reads Claude Code's status-line JSON on stdin, records its context-window
usage for this pane, and prints a status line. Install as Claude Code's
statusLine command; not normally run by hand.

Never fails: bad input or a storage error still prints something and
exits 0. A `statusline.command` in the global config (see 'workspace
config set') delegates rendering to another command; a slow or hung
delegate falls back to the built-in line.

Install it by adding this to ~/.claude/settings.json (or run
'workspace doctor --fix'):
  { "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "workspace statusline" } }

Each run records its reading against $TMUX_PANE (or $CLAUDE_PID), which
'workspace sessions --json' then reports. Run these examples outside an
agent's pane so they don't overwrite its real reading.

Examples:
  workspace statusline <<< '{"context_window":{"used_percentage":42}}'    # see the line Claude Code would show for 42% context used
  workspace statusline <<< '{}'    # empty input still prints a line and exits 0
  workspace statusline < payload.json    # replay a saved Claude Code payload while debugging a delegate command
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace statusline --bogus
--- exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
invalid option: --bogus
--- end
